title: Megurine Luka — Brand New School〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, let the strategy meeting for our SEKAI opening ceremony begin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Firstly, I asked Honami to run me through what happened at their opening ceremony again. Of the things she mentioned, I listed up a few that seemed important for ours, so I'll write those on the blackboard.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um... The opening remarks, the school anthem... The principal's... What does that say?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “Salutations”.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The principal's salutations—as in the talk they give.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well if that's what you mean, you shouldn't write it all complicated.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, but doesn't “the principal's salutations” sound more elegant than “the talk the principal gives”?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Plus, the opening ceremony is meant to be taken very seriously and must be done properly, so they use these kinds of grandiose expressions.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Is it true you can't talk while the ceremony's going on?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yikes...
What am I gonna do...? I might not be able to stay quiet for even a minute.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, hey, what are we gonna do for the school anthem?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'd be a lot of work to put a school anthem together, so how about we see if we can find a song that fits the mood?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll be the principal, so I'd like to ask you to be the vice principal and run the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That means I'm the MC, right?!
Woohoo, I get to talk!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: While that is true, just know everything you say is scripted.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aaall rise!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rin, no stretching out the words you say.
Try saying it quick and cool, like “All rise!”.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right, quick and cool! Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All rise!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I never thought we'd have an opening ceremony...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But it sounds interesting.
And Luka and Rin apparently put in a lot of work preparing for it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd been wondering lately about what those two were sneaking around for, but I guess this was it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, they're here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something about them feels different from...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Silence, please.
All rise!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
First, the opening remarks.
Principal Megurine, if you please.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now begins the first SEKAI Opening Ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Phew, it's over...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Well done, Rin.
You were a very dignified vice principal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Totally! I was so shocked when you suddenly came out all, “Silence, please.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. I was super cool saying all those fancy words so confidently, wasn't I?♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, very. And you were a great principal, Luka. You were so gentle while still having this sort of commanding presence.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
And I was surprised how proper those salutations were...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A year consists of months that play out one after another. Thinking of it this way makes a year seem long, and it feels as if we have plenty of time at our disposal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, what about when we consider that a month is made up of individual weeks, and a week of individual days?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To go further, a day is made up of individual hours, and an hour of mere minutes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When you consider this, does it change the way you feel about the time you thought you had so much of?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hearing Principal Luka's talk really made me want to treasure my time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I managed to act like a true principal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So Rin, were you able to get a taste of what an opening ceremony is like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I got a big huge taste of it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I kinda wondered what could be so interesting about it when I heard I wasn't allowed to talk freely and nobody would be saying anything fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I think I understand what you meant when you said it's meaningful because it's done seriously!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Seriously, huh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, outside of our performances, it was pretty new to be so serious that we couldn't laugh about doing something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, after the closing remarks, I got this feeling like, “Alright, let's do this!”♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, we were able to achieve our original goal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks so much for suggesting this, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was my pleasure, I had a wonderful time putting it together with you.
